title: fleet — vehicle management L3 depth
accounting_note: No account.move or account.analytic.line in community fleet; fleet_account bridge module required

claims_summary.topic: Manifest dependencies — base + mail only, standalone
Fleet declared as top-level application
fleet.vehicle model with mail + activity + avatar mixins
model_id (required), driver_id, future_driver_id, state_id fields
Configurable state via fleet.vehicle.state, default new_request
Computed odometer float backed by fleet.vehicle.odometer log
odometer_unit Selection: kilometers or miles, default kilometers
fleet.vehicle.odometer model — date, value, vehicle_id, driver_id
_get_odometer resolves last reading by max value not date
fleet.vehicle.log.contract — start/expiry dates, amount, state lifecycle
_compute_days_left returns integer days to expiry; -1 if closed
cost_frequency: no/daily/weekly/monthly/yearly; cost_generated monetary
Daily cron ir_cron_contract_costs_generator calls run_scheduler
scheduler_manage_contract_expiration: alert window, activity posting, state transitions
fleet.vehicle.log.services — amount, date, service_type_id, state (New/Running/Done/Cancelled)
_set_odometer on service log creates fleet.vehicle.odometer; UserError if zero
fleet.vehicle.cost.report SQL view (_auto=False) — service+contract costs monthly
Daily-cost proration: cost_generated * days_in_month_within_contract_window
Security: fleet_group_user (Officer) + fleet_group_manager (Administrator); multi-company rules
No account.move/analytic link in community — fleet_account bridge required
